summary_1line: Victor is accused of Clerval’s murder, collapses in illness and imprisonment, then is exonerated and resolved to return to Geneva to confront the monster.

image_candidates.scene_text: Victor is led to a coffin and collapses in horror upon seeing the lifeless body of Henry Clerval.
In a dim prison room, the pale and skeletal Victor awakens on a rough bed behind barred windows with a nurse dozing beside him.
At midnight on the ship’s deck, Victor lies staring at the stars as dark waves crash around him while he flees the Irish shore.
